local_window_policy: Within the sampled continuation window, take the unanimously suppressed anchor closest to higher kappa, and the nearest higher unanimously high-spin anchor. Keep every measured knot inside. This does not certify absence of transitions in unsampled support toward kappa0. Global scan families and outliers remain diagnostic.
scope: No root-MC uncertainty is calculated here. Observable conditional-MC intervals and sampling flags are joined from the source analyses; the root bracket/sensitivity ranges are descriptive only. Pooledxi/L centralcrossings are descriptive checks. Exploratory fixed finite-box Binder locators within strong staggered-nematic response. All start/half/threshold/interpolation families retained, including failures. Anchor brackets and variant unions are descriptive, not calibrated confidence intervals or thermodynamic estimates. Pooling never removes incompatible starts. No assumed universality or fitted asymptote.
